info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Cross Channel Contact Routings-spec
info.description: The Cross Channel Contact Routing API provides a comprehensive overview of the contact routing strategies deployed across various communication channels within the banking system. This endpoint allows users to query and retrieve accurate contact routing configurations, enabling businesses to enhance customer interactions. Typical consumers of this API include customer service teams and integration developers who need to optimize routing capabilities for improved service delivery. It serves as a critical tool for ensuring that customer inquiries are directed to the appropriate channels efficiently.

get.summary: Retrieve contact routing information across channels.
